_comment: Example partition for tools/exp/contig/sealed.py (2026-10-14): ne-48-bal (overnight.POINTS: national 14, WH 10, FI 21, WIFI 3).

The Northeast corridor NY NJ PA DE MD DC VA is sealed in national, WH and FI (one run, the three channels drawn together); 'rest': true adds the channel's other footprint states with K = the point's K less the corridor's. WIFI (15 NE+plains states, whole) is one unsealed rest region.

K: tools/exp/region_arith.py (branch m5-studio/region-arith) has no row for this state set (its corridor variants B1/B7 add New England or drop VA), so the numbers are its arithmetic done on this corridor: overnight.fit_delta on the dollar extract, $M national 4,033.1, WH 3,145.7, FI 5,094.5.

Window-feasible K in the corridor: national 3 (final delta 0.0692) or 4 (0.0082), WH 3 (0.0967), FI 6 (0.099) or 5 (0.0157); the rest then takes national 11, WH 7, FI 15, all window-feasible. The roomier K are the primary; k_alt is the other feasible K, used once, only if the drawing ends infeasible or unknown (its band is a hair).
The DE-VA forbid pair is the one the 2026-10-13 w1-50 DC+DE+MD+VA region needed (notes/2026-10-13_overnight-grid-to-regional-sealing.md).
